title: The Breton Succession

opening.boundary: Authored late-year cutoff after the stated background developments; not their occurrence date.
opening.label: 15 December 1341 · after the year’s turning points

briefing: The death of Brittany's duke has opened competing Montfort and Penthièvre–Blois claims; the older John of Montfort has been captured. Brittany is contested; no single kingdom-wide ownership flag resolves each town or castle. English and French support intersects with a Breton succession dispute rather than erasing local actors.
